# Payve

> Payve is the payment network for supply chain trade, with two products. The Payve Network: members enroll once and pay any supplier instantly across the US, Mexico, Colombia, Brazil, and the European Union in the supplier's own currency, with no wire fees, from one operating account. Every supplier they pay gains the option of early payment (working capital) on approved invoices. Suppliers enroll at no cost, and when they enroll, their own suppliers gain the same. Agentic Intelligence: agents that run on the network's connected payment and invoice data plus the customer's existing systems, answering business questions in plain English or Spanish, delivering scheduled briefings, and automating order entry, document matching, reconciliation, and complaint root-cause analysis. A person approves every write.

Payve is a financial technology company, not a bank.

## Products

- [The Payve Network](https://www.getpayve.com/products/network): Enroll once. Send a payment and it's there: domestic and international suppliers paid from one approval, in local currency, across the US, Mexico, Colombia, Brazil, and the EU. Members are connected to global liquidity: suppliers who enroll can choose early payment on approved invoices, seeing the exact dollars and fee first, and buyers earn income on every election. Funds live in one operating account, and every payment lands as connected data.
- [Agentic Intelligence](https://www.getpayve.com/products/agentic-intelligence): Agents on the network's connected data and your existing systems: plain-English/Spanish answers, scheduled briefings, order entry, document matching, reconciliation without chasing wire references, complaint root cause, and Loops (scheduled checks). A person approves every write.

## Solutions

- [Fresh produce](https://www.getpayve.com/solutions/fresh-produce): Growers, shippers, and distributors moving perishables.
- [Seafood](https://www.getpayve.com/solutions/seafood): Importers and processors with cold chain operations.
- [Packaging](https://www.getpayve.com/solutions/packaging): Packhouses and packaging suppliers to the food industry.

- [Customer stories](https://www.getpayve.com/customers): Supply chain businesses across the US, Mexico, and Colombia run on Payve.
